content.comment_body: I have a question. I want to display, on the same line and screen, the values of the analog threshold triggers B001 and B002 along with the unit (bars in my case). The issue is that one value block takes up space for 7 characters, while the actual value only needs 3 characters. Is there any way to make this block smaller so I can place the unit directly after the value?

You can achieve this with a [article_no]. You would need to enable [product_name] feature in the message text settings. This would allow you to scroll the message across the first line, which effectively doubles the screen width.

It’s not possible to reduce the size of a parameter. The software reserves the maximum possible field size for values (commonly +/-32767 or 999999). However, by using the GBK character set, as [user_name] suggested, you get 16 characters per line instead of 12. You’ll find this under File -> Message text settings.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated by the fixed space allocated for value display blocks, which is larger than needed for practical use. This limitation prevents adding measurement units or extra information easily on a single line. Suggestions include enabling text scrolling and switching to a character set that allows more characters per line, but direct adjustment of block size isn’t supported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like the ability to reduce the size of value display blocks, making it possible to fit more information, such as measurement units, on a single line.
